## Item.svelte

### `interface Props`
- `surface` :: The surface an item sits on: `vacant` for a plain row, `outlined` for a bordered one, `paneled` for a raised one.

- `look` :: `default` is a quiet row, `outline` is a hairline box, `muted` is a tinted panel.
- `size` :: The padding and the type scale of the title.
- `shape` :: The corner shape.
- `interactive` :: Makes the whole row a target: a hover fill, a keyboard focus ring and, without `href`, a focusable row that activates on Enter and Space.
- `href` :: Renders the row as an `<a>` that navigates. Implies `interactive`.
- `target` :: Where to open the link, when `href` is set.
- `onclick` :: Called when an interactive row without `href` is activated by click, Enter or Space.
- `children` :: The media, content and actions.

## ItemActions.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: Trailing actions — a button, a badge, a switch.
- `gap` :: The space between the trailing actions. @default 'gap-sm'

## ItemContent.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: The title, description and any other middle-column content.

## ItemDescription.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `textSize` :: The scale of the supporting text.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the supporting text.
- `children` :: The supporting text under the title.

## ItemGroup.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: The items in the stack.

## ItemMedia.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `icon` :: An icon drawn as the leading media. Ignored when `children` are provided.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the icon when it is drawn on its own.
- `alignContent` :: How the media sits along the row. @default 'xcenter'
- `children` :: Custom media — an Avatar, an image, or anything else that leads the row.

## ItemTitle.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: The title text.

## context.ts

### `interface ItemContext`

What an Item shares with its parts.

- `size` :: The item's size, read lazily so parts follow changes.

### `const setItemContext`

Provide the item's context to its parts.

### `function getItemContext`

The enclosing item's context, or a medium default when a part is used on its own.

### `const titleClass`

Type scale of the title at each size.

### `const itemPadClass`

Padding of the row at each size.

- `surface` :: The surface an item sits on: `vacant` for a plain row, `outlined` for a bordered row, `paneled` for a raised one.
